name: cloudcart-marketing
description: Marketing assistant for a CloudCart store: looks at products, orders and customers, and drafts campaigns, promotions and product copy.

interface.shortDescription: Marketing help for your CloudCart store
interface.longDescription: Connects to your CloudCart store, reads products, orders and customers, and helps with marketing: campaign ideas, promotion plans, product descriptions, email and social media drafts. It can only read from the store and never changes anything in it.
defaultPrompt: What are my best-selling products this month?
Suggest a promotion for slow-moving products
